name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service
description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service is an AI-assisted service platform for cases, customer interactions, knowledge, unified routing, digital channels, voice, service-level agreements, entitlements, analytics, and representative productivity on Microsoft Dataverse.
agentUseSummary: Choose the Dataverse environment hosting Customer Service, connect through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth, and let selected agents verify only the bound environment and minimized user, organization, and business-unit IDs. Relay does not expose cases, customers, conversations, knowledge, channels, routing, analytics, arbitrary Dataverse operations, or mutations in V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One environment-bound WhoAmI check runs directly. Customer and support data, arbitrary Dataverse access, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one environment-bound Dataverse WhoAmI wrapper through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth.
Railway mounts one environment-bound Dataverse WhoAmI wrapper through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's multi-tenant Entra application has not been configured and accepted for production Dynamics CRM user_impersonation and the exact Customer Service callback, and no licensed customer environment has completed consent and acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console owner updates Relay's verified multi-tenant Entra application, adds the exact callback, grants delegated Dynamics CRM user_impersonation, stores the client ID and secret in Railway, then validates OAuth, refresh, WhoAmI, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in a licensed non-production customer environment.

evidence.supports: Microsoft documents Customer Service capabilities spanning cases, interactions, knowledge, routing, channels, voice, SLAs, entitlements, analytics, and Copilot agents over customer-service data.
Microsoft documents WhoAmI as the Dataverse function that retrieves the current system-user context.
Microsoft requires OAuth for Dataverse Web API clients and documents environment-qualified delegated user_impersonation.

Microsoft documents broad Customer Service MCP actions over cases, knowledge, email, and service operations and warns about privilege enforcement, external data flow, cascading failure, and human oversight; Relay does not expose that broad surface in V1.
